name: Christopher Angatookalook
bio: Christopher Angatookalook is an Inuk athlete and actor from the Nunavik region of Quebec. He is best known for his debut film performance in the 2026 film Labrador: Autopsy of Silence, for which he won the award for Best Performance in an International Narrative Feature at the 2026 Tribeca Film Festival.

credits.title: Labrador – Autopsy of Silence
credits.overview: In the icy waters of Labrador, in Canada's Arctic north, a cargo ship races to deliver the last supply run of the season to the region's isolated communities – until the murder of a crew member shatters the fragile balance of the voyage.
